name: pstack_run
obligation: Register a pstack_run tool with action arm, state, iterate, verify, discard, inconclusive, checkpoint, blocked, handoff, stop, or list.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/run-controller-contracts.test.ts@pstack_run registers the mandated action set

obligation: Start a run in DEFINE_PREDICATE and advance it to WAIT_FOR_EVENT_OR_HEARTBEAT only when a predicate_defined event carries a checkable predicate.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@predicate_defined moves DEFINE_PREDICATE to WAIT_FOR_EVENT_OR_HEARTBEAT

obligation: Refuse to redefine the finish predicate once defined so the finish condition is never relaxed.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@predicate_defined refuses to relax an already defined predicate

obligation: Wake a waiting run on a heartbeat or an event wake, count each wake as a fire, and return a declarative wake effect.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@heartbeat moves WAIT_FOR_EVENT_OR_HEARTBEAT to RESUME_OR_START_ITERATION

obligation: Record a non-null event id on the run and treat a repeated event_wake with an already-seen id as a no-op.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@duplicate event_wake with the same event id is a no-op

obligation: Open exactly one iteration per iteration_started event and move the run to ACT.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@iteration_started moves RESUME_OR_START_ITERATION to ACT with an open iteration

obligation: Move the run to VERIFY on a verification_started event so every iteration is verified before its verdict.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@verification_started moves ACT to VERIFY

obligation: Close the open iteration as advanced with its evidence and reset the discard counter.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@iteration_verified closes the open iteration as advanced

obligation: Close the open iteration as discarded and increment consecutiveDiscards.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@iteration_discarded increments consecutiveDiscards

obligation: Write a checkpoint from COMMIT_IF_ADVANCED_OR_DISCARD and then evaluate the finish predicate before resolving the run.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@checkpoint moves COMMIT_IF_ADVANCED_OR_DISCARD to CHECKPOINT

obligation: Return an unresolved predicate from CHECK_PREDICATE to WAIT_FOR_EVENT_OR_HEARTBEAT.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@predicate_unmet returns CHECK_PREDICATE to WAIT_FOR_EVENT_OR_HEARTBEAT

obligation: Complete a run only when the model asserts the predicate holds through a predicate_met event carrying evidence.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@predicate_met with evidence completes the run

obligation: Never complete a run on a predicate_met event whose evidence is empty.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@predicate_met without evidence never completes

obligation: Block a run after plateauLimit consecutive non-advancing iterations and name the plateau in the blocked reason.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@three consecutive discards block the run on plateau

obligation: Count inconclusive verdicts toward the plateau like discards and report them with a distinct message.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@inconclusive counts toward the plateau and is reported distinctly

obligation: Ignore every further event on a COMPLETE run.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@completed records ignore further events

obligation: Ignore events on a BLOCKED run except stop.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@blocked records ignore further events except stop

obligation: Block a hosted run when the hosted runtime is unavailable and never continue it locally.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@hosted_unavailable blocks a remote-required run and never continues locally

obligation: Record the hosted handoff endpoint and mark the run BLOCKED locally because hosted continuation is a prerequisite the local runtime cannot supply, never downgrading to local execution.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@handoff_requested stores the endpoint and blocks the run locally

obligation: Never mutate the input run record while reducing an event.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-fsm.test.ts@reduceRun never mutates the input record

obligation: Persist each run record under PSTACK_RUNS_DIR and round trip it through save and load.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-store.test.ts@saveRun and loadRun round trip a record

obligation: Save a run record atomically with a temp file in the same directory and rename, leaving no temp file behind.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-store.test.ts@saveRun writes atomically and leaves no temp file behind

obligation: List stored run records and select the most recently updated one as latest.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-store.test.ts@listRuns collects records and latestRun picks the most recently updated

obligation: Report a corrupt run record with its path instead of treating it as a fresh run.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-store.test.ts@corrupt JSON is reported instead of treated as a fresh run

obligation: Reject a run id that is malformed or escapes the runs directory.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/loop-store.test.ts@traversal and malformed run ids are rejected

obligation: Route a programmatic run arm through the registered heartbeat runtime so the loop controller never owns a timer of its own.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/run-controller-contracts.test.ts@arm routes the run through the heartbeat wake path
